channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Anti-terror panel’s Öcalan visit historic, Bahçeli says - Türkiye News
item.description: Nationalist Movement Party’s (MHP) Chairman Devlet Bahçeli has described a visit by a group of lawmakers to the İmralı prison island to meet jailed PKK leader Abdullah Öcalan as a historic development for achieving a terror-free Türkiye, while criticizing the political parties which refused to take part in the mission.

item.title: Museums hand over operations to children for a day - Türkiye News
item.description: For one extraordinary day, Türkiye’s museums belonged entirely to children: As part of the global “Museum Takeover Day,” young visitors across the country seized control — from selling tickets and guiding tours to running official social media accounts.

item.title: İznik tightens security ahead of Pope Leo XIV’s historic visit - Türkiye News
item.description: Security measures have been tightened in the northwestern province of Bursa’s İznik district ahead of the upcoming visit of Pope Leo XIV, the spiritual leader of the Catholic Church and Head of the Vatican City State.

item.title: 29 provinces surpass $1 bln in exports over 10 months - Latest News
item.description: Türkiye saw 29 provinces exceed $1 billion in exports from January to October, with 46 provinces recording increases, according to Trade Ministry data.

item.title: Türkiye, World Bank launch $6 bln energy financing talks - Latest News
item.description: Türkiye has agreed with the World Bank to initiate work on a financing package worth up to $6 billion to expand the country's electricity transmission infrastructure, Energy and Natural Resources Minister Alparslan Bayraktar has announced.

item.title: China's Xi pushes Taiwan issue in call with Trump - World News
item.description: Chinese leader Xi Jinping pressed the ever-sensitive issue of Taiwan in a phone call Monday with U.S. President Donald Trump, as he stressed the need to build on a fragile trade truce between the two superpowers.

item.title: Türkiye unites on Nov 25 to combat violence against women - Türkiye News
item.description: Thousands took to the streets across Türkiye on Nov. 25 for the International Day for the Elimination of Violence Against Women, spotlighting the country’s ongoing femicide crisis through nationwide rallies, vigils and calls for stronger protections.

item.title: Ukraine, Russia trade deadly strikes as negotiators hammer at deal - World News
item.description: Russia rained missiles and drones overnight on Kiev, killing six people, authorities said on Tuesday, as three people died in Russia's Rostov region in massive Ukrainian strikes.

item.title: Lack of pressure encourages Israel’s massacres on Palestinians: Erdoğan - Türkiye News
item.description: The failure of the international community in putting sufficient pressure on Israel has encouraged the Netanyahu government to exercise its massacres on the Palestinian civilians, mostly children and women, President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan has said.

item.title: Gaza 'survival' at stake, as recovery to take decades: UN - World News
item.description: Israel's war in Gaza has ravaged the Palestinian territory's economy and is threatening its very survival, the United Nations warned on Nov. 25, calling for "immediate and substantial" international intervention.
